text:
maya: heads-up — opened a small PR to centralize provider blocks and pin a few module versions. planning to regen the providers lockfile after CI passes. hoping for a quick review this morning.

sam: ack. can you paste the provider change? want to make sure nothing surprises state import.

maya: sure — moved aws provider to root (keeps provider aliases for cross-account modules). snippet:```terraform
provider "aws" {
  region = var.region
  version = "~> 4.50"
}
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/internal-terraform-modules.git//vpc?ref=v2.3.1"
}
```

priya: nice. question — any state move required for the module split? the old vpc module was referenced in a couple of envs.

maya: yeah one state move for prod (renamed module path). I added a migration note in the PR and a tfstate mv command. will coordinate during a low-traffic window.

eli: also watch for provider constraints in third-party modules — some still pin older provider versions. recommend doing a `terraform providers mirror` + lock regen in CI job.

sam: fwiw, regen command I used earlier: `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64`. ensures lockfile covers our runners and dev machines.

maya: thanks — I added that to the pipeline. CI will run lock regen and include diff commit if changed.

priya: about secrets wiring — did you check the secret provider mapping? we moved kms key rotation earlier this week. modules expecting a specific KMS alias might fail.

maya: good catch. updated module inputs to accept `kms_key_arn` and default to module-managed key. for prod I wired the existing alias into the env module.

sam: can someone do a quick smoke plan on staging before we merge? I can take it if you want @maya.

maya: thanks — that'd be great. please use the `staging-lockfile` branch so regen diffs are visible.

infra-bot: CI check passed — 4 checks, 0 failures. Plan size: 3 resources to add, 1 to change. details: https://ci.redwood/12345

eli: looks small. one more note — prefer exact pins for provider plugins in the lockfile for releases. avoid broad ranges unless we have auto-upgrade gating.

maya: agreed. I'll change the provider version to `= 4.50.0` in the release branch.

priya: will coordinate state move with oncall for the prod window. tagging calendar. :calendar:

sam: lgtm from me pending canary plan.

maya: thanks all — merging after smoke plan and a brief rollback doc. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging apply started by sam at 1867654600.

sam: apply done, no drift. leaving a note in the PR with plan output.

maya: merging now — will watch metrics.

eli: ping me if anything weird shows up in the provider compatibility tests.

priya: noted.

maya: done. thanks everyone!
